title: Full support of the zero-temperature Sherrington-Kirkpatrick order parameter
main_claim: Every minimizer γ of the zero-temperature Parisi functional for the pure zero-field SK model (ξ=t²/2) has supp μ_γ=[0,1), with E u(t,X_t)²=t and E Φ_xx(t,X_t)²=1. Corollaries: γ is smooth, γ(0)=0, γ'>0 on (0,1).
coverage: Checked with sympy: the rational polynomial identity in Lemma cert:identity-lemma, done symbolically with exact rationals. The remainder in R,K,v,B,j matches all 22 entries of Table cert:table exactly, every entry is positive, and z and L drop out. Re-derived by hand: the D-rules (shape:D-rules); the divergence identity W(F)f=∂x(rfF); S=2rH_x and B=-2H; the curvature formulas (eq:first-curvature) and (eq:second-curvature) via the Itô drifts of r, v, w; the backward evolutions for H and H_x, including the terminal signs, the source sign wH≥0 and the jump updates; the forward score evolutions for s, a and s_xx, and the comparison for a-1/t. The ρ=d_s-d_r evolution (shape:G-evolution) was checked symbolically. Also re-derived: jump invariance of j; ρ≥0 on the first step; the first-variation formula, including the PDE difference and signs; the contact conditions (adding and removing Stieltjes mass, Fubini); the terminal-plateau boundary-layer bound 1-q≥C√(1-t); and the case split in the main proof (initial, interior and terminal gaps, c>0 and c=0, and the one-sided endpoint at 0). For the regularity corollary I checked the moment identities and the density identity 2γ'Ea³=Ed²-12γE ab²+6γ²Ea⁴, and that its scaling matches Proposition cert:coercivity. The monotone plateau-insertion approximation is valid. Not re-derived in detail: Lemma regularity (compact-strip derivative convergence for integrable γ), the Gaussian tail-class lemma, and the algorithm and consequences sections.
sibling_notes: Sibling QAOA paper (rank 154) depends on this paper non-circularly. The shared fact it uses, full support / strictly increasing minimizer, is supported by this audit.
